Look at the size of these patch notes: https://forum-en.guildwars2.com/forum/info/updates/Game-Update-Notes-April-19-2016

This is a free update for a game with no monthly sub and the vast majority of these changes are actual mechanic / content additions as opposed to simple technical bug fixes.

This is how you support a game's community the right way.

Some quotes that highlight ANET's development philsophy and why it's good for it's players.

"This update is about reducing grind, increasing rewards, and getting to the fun faster."

"It’s the result of an effort we undertook across all parts of the Guild Wars 2 team to pause new development for a while and instead focus on improving the existing game."

"With the Guild Wars® franchise, we’ve always tried to get players to the fun quickly. And not just to the fun, but quickly to the new content too, so you can play with your friends... That base game leveling experience is still a lot of fun, but sometimes as a player, you want to see the new stuff now while still playing through the older stuff at your own pace. With this quarterly update, we’re giving all existing and new Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns purchasers a max-level character boost, so you can immediately get one of your characters to the new jungle and Living World content."

"This new max-level boost item will be delivered to you in a new, free shared inventory slot, which is yours to keep even after you use the character boost. Another thing I love about this boost item is that you can test it on as many different characters as you want before consuming it. So, if you haven’t already done so, now you can check out how every profession in the game plays at max level!"

"This quarterly update also has a lot of WvW changes, and it marks the start of live beta testing of WvW development. In March, we asked the community to choose WvW development priorities; this update includes improvements for each of the community’s top four stated priorities."

"We have thirty pages of release notes for you to read today, but better yet, come join us in the game and check out all these changes for yourself."
